headline: How to Get Besauce
title: How to Get Besauce in Aniimo | Pathfinder Fragments Trade | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Besauce cannot be caught in the open world, but you can still get it. Beat NPC Pathfinder Challenges, since some of them reward Besauce Fragments. Collect forty fragments, then visit an Outpost shop and open Trade, then Item Exchange. Check each challenge's reward panel first, and plan your Pathfinder runs around those rewards. Have you got Besauce yet? Comment below!
description: Besauce in Aniimo is obtained by collecting 40 Besauce Fragments from Pathfinder Challenges and trading them at an Outpost shop.
